subject: Renewal options & evidence retention tiers for compliance platform
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: procurement@vanta.io
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal options & evidence retention tiers for compliance platform

Hi Vanta team,

We're approaching our renewal window and want to review available options for the next 12–24 months. Two quick asks up front so we can prepare internally before a call:

1) Pricing by evidence-retention tier (we're interested in 90d / 365d / unlimited retention options) and any per-record vs per-user accounting you do. Please attach a simple sheet we can import into our cost model.
2) Professional services / migration assistance: we may want credits for onboarding a new retention policy and training for our security team. Include typical days and rates.
3) SLA and credits: what's your standard latency/uptime SLA for the enterprise tier, and do you offer service credits?
4) Exportability: we need an easy export of raw evidence (audit logs, config snapshots). Any limits?

I've attached our current evidence inventory (redwood_evidence_inventory.csv) to help you map which collections need longer retention. We're leaning toward >=365 days for infra logs, but could be tiered for app-level artifacts.

Please share a concise pricing sheet and availability for a 30-min call next week. If Drata has equivalent options, feel free to include comparative notes — we are evaluating both vendors.

Thanks,

Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Vanta Procurement <procurement@vanta.io>

Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 12:01:23 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal options & evidence retention tiers for compliance platform

Hi Dylan — great to hear from you and thanks for the inventory.

High level responses below and a pricing sheet is attached (vendor_pricing_sheet_vanta.xlsx):

- Retention tiers: we support 90/365/unlimited. Pricing is a combination of base license + per-evidence-row storage at scale. See tab "RetentionPricing" in the sheet.
- Professional services: we offer a one-time migration package (5 days of engineering + 3 days of enablement) or an extended package (15 days). We can convert a portion of these days to credits for renewals > 12 months.
- SLA: 99.95% standard enterprise SLA; credits start at 99.9% breaches. We include priority support in enterprise plans.
- Exportability: full export via API for audit artifacts; exports above 1TB/day may be throttled — we can add bulk-export windows as part of the SOW.

Call availability next week: Mon/Tue 10–12 PT or Thu 13–16 PT. If you send a short agenda I will bring our solution architect.

Best,
Erin Mills
Renewals Manager
Vanta

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: monica.patel@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai

Subject: Fwd: Renewal options & evidence retention tiers for compliance platform

Forwarding Vanta's response — see attached pricing sheet. Quick internal ask so we don't waste vendor cycles:

Proposed negotiation playbook (draft):
- Must-haves: 365-day retention for infra logs, API export within 24 hours, SOC2 automation hooks preserved.
- Nice-to-have: 90-day bundled retention for lower-tier app artifacts to reduce cost.
- Commercial ask: 15–25% renewal discount off list + 5 PS days credited toward migration.
- Legal ask: pro-rata refund for mid-term terminations, right-to-audit bounds, and an export assurance clause.

Next steps:
- Neha: confirm technical must-haves and whether 365 is adequate for all infra collections (can you map to inventory?).
- Marcus: confirm commercial/legal constraints we should not compromise on (indemnity, termination).
- Monica: if this should run via procurement RFP or we continue bilateral with Vanta.

I penciled a quick 30-minute meeting slot on Tue 11/24 10:00 PT with Vanta; hold until we confirm. Link to HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/8456123/HC-2026-0917-REN

Thanks — Dylan

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>

Agree with the playbook. A couple of specifics from security side:

- 365 days is our floor for infra logs; for container audit trails we should aim for 2x (730) if the cost delta is reasonable.
- Need guaranteed export cadence (daily snapshot) and proof of export integrity (checksums) in the SOW.
- Please push for at least 10 PS days credited; we'll use those for evidence remapping + runbooks.
- Add a clause that vendors must notify us and provide a temporary export if they plan product deprecation that affects exports.

I'll take point on mapping the inventory to specific retention buckets — plan to deliver a short mapping doc by EOB Friday. Schedule the call after we confirm mapping so we can be precise on ask.

-Neha Kapoor
Senior Security PM
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal options & evidence retention tiers for compliance platform

High level legal notes:

- Termination: include a termination-for-convenience clause with pro-rata refunds for prepaid services and an exit plan that includes raw artifact export in a machine-readable format.
- Indemnity & limits: keep our indemnity reciprocal and cap at a reasonable dollar threshold; do not accept open-ended indemnities for third-party data.
- Professional services: if they credit PS days, carve out scope that does not include premium engineering troubleshooting. We should define "migration assistance" deliverables in SOW.
- Data escrow / escrow for config: recommend escrow for critical export format if vendor is strategic — we can pilot instead of full escrow for now.

I'll produce a redline of the draft SOW and key contract clauses; attaching a working draft (draft_renewal_SOW.docx). Please review and flag anything commercial that would block negotiation.

Marcus Lin
Lead Counsel, Commercial
Redwood Inference
